module.title: Server: Log: Request
module.description:
Log for requests on web applications.
Automatically logs all HTTP requests.
module.author: Christian Würker

config.name: delay
config.title: Flag: save to file first, import with job later

module.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_requests`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_requests` ( `requestId` int(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `ip` varchar(63) NOT NULL, `method` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `url` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `request` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `session` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `cookie` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `headers` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `timestamp` datetime(6) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`requestId`), KEY `ip` (`ip`), KEY `method` (`method`), KEY `url` (`url`), KEY `timestamp` (`timestamp`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
